text:
Noah: quick idea for the trace timeline minimap — make it keyboard-focusable and surface an export/share action from the minimap context so users can grab a timeline slice quickly. cc @Ivy @Ravi
Ivy: Nice. Two implementation questions: how granular is the slice (timebox vs selected spans) and where does the filename/meta come from?
Ravi: From a11y POV make minimap an ARIA slider or roving tablist with aria-valuemin/valuemax. When a range is selected focus should move to a small toolbar: "Download slice (.json)", "Copy permalink".
Marta: Accessibility checklist: announce range start/end using aria-live, expose handles as buttons with labels like "Start handle" and "End handle". Ensure the export dialog receives focus and focus returns to the minimap handle after close.
Olivia: Microcopy: prefer "Download timeline slice (.json)" and "Copy link to selection". Short toast: "Link copied". Also show approximate payload size in the export dialog for large slices.
Noah: UX question: should permalink include an optional anonymize toggle? legal asked for an easy reminder that exported traces might include PII. We could add a small checkbox: "Redact sensitive fields".
Ivy: Good call. Add help text and a link to data-export policy. For keyboard users provide a toggle + label and default to redact=true for enterprise tenants.
Ravi: Keyboard shortcuts proposal: when minimap focused: "s" start selection, "e" end selection, "p" copy permalink, "d" download slice. Document in shortcut palette and gate behind a feature flag. Also ensure no conflict with global search.
Marta: For screen readers: on selection completion announce: "Selection 12.3s to 45.8s selected. Press D to download or P to copy link." role=status.
Olivia: File naming suggestion: trace-<corrid>-slice-<start>-<end>.json with a preview of the name editable in the dialog. Keep GDPR blurb under the checkbox.
Noah: Analytics: track minimap_slice_created, minimap_export_start, minimap_copy_permalink. Also track redact_toggle used.
deploy-bot: ui-preview/minimap-slice-v1 deployed to staging (build #2510). :rocket:
Ivy: I'll add annotated keyboard flow to the Figma file and include aria attributes. Ravi/Marta please review SR announcements and the a11y checklist.
Ravi: will review. Marta: will write the screen-reader acceptance steps and include voiceover/NVDA notes.
